mcqs.question: How do you explain a family's role around practice?

options.text: I describe support as curiosity, rest, and one consistent cue. Young players do better without several adults coaching at once.
I ask which part worries them and return to the learning goal. A specific conversation is healthier than competing instructions.
I would invite them to observe one skill-focused practice. Seeing the routine may make encouragement simpler and more consistent.

mcqs.rationale: The correct option reproduces the answer to this held-out question; the alternatives come from related answers or reverse its intent.
